viewing_check: Tip the jar or look through the glass for anything larger than a shooter, handmade swirls (German, Lutz, onionskin), sulphides, Akro Agate corkscrews, Christensen or Peltier Rainbo/Banana types, and mint-condition tiger or oxblood marbles. Without those the lot is a typical jar.
